newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 12.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 12.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* The Dow Jones industrial average hit a fourth consecutive record, closing at 7575.83, up 36.56 points on Wednesday.
* The Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange Composite Index shed 2.11 points or 0.19 percent to 1,108.25 on weakness in key index component Telekom, which lost 30 cents to 12.20 ringgit.
* Focus could be on stocks linked to Ekran chief Ting Pek Khiing, after a disappointing rights subscription.

* Ekran's rights offer of 257.143 million shares was undersubscribed by 62.77 percent. Ting bought up 150.98 million or the 161.417 million units not taken up, boosting his stake in the Bakun dam promoter to 55.7 percent from 26.3 percent.

* Ting's purchase of the rights raised speculation he may have to restructure his holdings in other companies to raise financing. He is the controlling shareholder in Granite Industries, PWE Industries Bhd and Pacific Chemicals Bhd.
* In other news, Sungei Way Construction Bhd is set to list on the main board, with an offer price of 1.50 ringgit a share for 47.9 million shares.

* Overall sentiment on stock market remains weak, analysts say. "I think there's room for it to correct further," the head of research at a domestic firm said. "I don't think genuine investors are coming in. I see play by syndicate funds."
